top root/opamp_tb.shbench for Ngspice
== root/buffer.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  prefix x
  category subcircuit
  provenance "xschem root/buffer.sym"
  xfp faa9f2870d5fa243

pin IN in -40 0
pin OUT out 40 0
pin IB in 0 40

param size 1

impl schematic schematic
  format spice "{name} {pins} {cell}"

rect -30 -20 30 30
  layer 4
  fill false

stext -30 -35 R0 {cell}
  size 0.2
  layer 3

inst zsxx7z ./opamp
  at 0 0 R0
  name X1
  wn 2*size
  wp 4*size

label 6xg72f -40 20 R0 OUT

port 13jnva -40 -20 R0 IN
port ayw2jq 0 40 R0 IB
port jwy6c8 40 0 R0 OUT

== root/nmos.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  prefix M
  category primitive
  provenance "xschem root/nmos.sym"
  xfp 61d3fe40784dc67a

pin D inout 20 -30
pin G in -20 0
pin S inout 20 30
pin B inout 20 0

param W 1
param L 0.15
param nf 1
param model nfet
  kind string

impl spice spice
  format spice "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {B} {model} W='({W})*1u' L='({L})*1u' nf={nf} ad='(({W})*0.29)*1p'"
  format cdl "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {B} {model} W='({W})*1u' L='({L})*1u'"

rect -20 -20 20 20
  layer 4
  fill false

stext -20 -35 R0 {cell}
  size 0.2
  layer 3
== root/opamp.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  prefix x
  category subcircuit
  provenance "xschem root/opamp.sym"
  xfp 690c75eea44fe07a

pin INP in -40 -20
pin INN in -40 20
pin OUT out 40 0

param cc 1p

  L l

  L l

  global true

== root/opamp_tb.shbench
schemify 1 shbench
  provenance "xschem root/opamp_tb.sch"
  xfp 5d671bf4f6f8fc1e

inst 9k4asj ./buffer
  at 0 200 R0
  name XB2
  size 2
inst b6wkzc ./vsource
  at -200 0 R0
  name VIN
  dc 0.9
inst fm1yz6 ./vsource
  at -300 0 R0
  name VDD
  dc 1.8
inst h7s5g9 ./buffer
  at 0 0 R0
  name XB1
inst nr3455 ./buffer
  at 0 400 R0
  name XB3

label 0abs1g -40 400 R0 in
label 12ehpp 0 40 R0 ib
label 3n07y7 -300 -30 R0 vdd!
  global true
label 8xv6xp -300 30 R0 0
label 91evct -40 200 R0 in
label 92w241 40 200 R0 o2
label hg7f8t -200 30 R0 0
label hrsw1a -40 0 R0 in
label k580mr 0 240 R0 ib
label k93kbg -200 -30 R0 in
label kx4snq 40 400 R0 o3
label my0x1f 40 0 R0 o1
label w94ssh 0 440 R0 ib

code corner spice
  | .temp 27
